briefdescription.para: Generate synthetic PCM float samples (silence + low-energy noise).
Whisper transcription benchmark — plugin overhead and CLI parity harness.

detaileddescription.para: Validates: WHISPER-PHASE5: Define API limits for file size and sample-rate ranges

Scenarios:
WhisperPlugin::transcribe() latency in stub mode (plugin overhead)
WhisperPlugin::detectLanguage() latency
transcribeFile() call overhead (no real file I/O on CI)
WhisperStubTranscriber direct — raw interface dispatch cost
Varying PCM buffer sizes (16 kHz, 8 kHz) — API boundary coverage
Statistics query cost
CLI comparison harness: logs expected real-model latency budget (< 2× real-time for 30-second audio on a 4-core CPU)

When THEMIS_ENABLE_WHISPER is defined and THEMIS_BENCH_WHISPER_MODEL_PATH points to a valid GGML model the benchmarks exercise the real inference path. Without a model the stub path is used and results represent pure dispatch overhead — a useful CI regression guard.
